title: Alignment Plan Care Points on Treadwear Credits — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Care-package points are added to the covered-mileage percentage of a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty treadwear adjustment credit, following the vehicle's Crestline alignment plan under Alignment Services & Plans and the date of the latest alignment performed on that plan.

| Alignment plan on the vehicle | Latest performed alignment on the plan | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| active lifetime alignment plan (Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan, Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance) | fewer than 12 months old | 10 |
| active Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan or Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan | fewer than 12 months old | 5 |
| any other vehicle | — | 0 |

The age of the latest alignment is counted in whole calendar months from the alignment date to today.

**Both sides of the window (hypothetical dates):** an alignment performed 11 whole months ago is fewer than 12 months old; one performed 12 whole months ago is not, and the vehicle earns 0 whatever its plan. A vehicle with only a single-service alignment, or whose plan is not active, earns 0.
